steps.name: Verify distribution configuration and shell entry points

scope: Includes new workspace-domain simulator execution (34 common cases,14 selection cases) and full Xcode compilation of typed app navigation. App bootstrap/navigation tests execute on desktop, not in this simulator workflow. Full hosted core and collaboration-domain simulator tests plus Xcode application, including five point-read and three durable-dismissal intent cases. Common application action coordinator is compiled; its actual Koin/SQLite behavior is exercised separately on desktop with a simulated OS display. Android action callbacks are proved separately on API35; this Apple build compiles the common callback coordinators but does not execute Android or SystemUI. Requires two AppleCommandPrevention Room cases, seven discard/six observe/fourteen complete cases, and preceding protected-input domain/raw cases. Saved-reply UI, VM, actual Koin and encrypted feature repositories compile into Xcode; their tests execute separately on desktop/SQLite/real browser, not in this simulator task. Production native notification hosts remain unbound and chat push OFF. Physical iPhone waived; no APNs/CallKit acceptance.
